easyPrerequisites:
King Macar doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Aphetto Alchemist is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
description:
Activate King Macar using Aphetto Alchemist's ability by tapping it, untapping King Macar
King Macar triggers, allowing you to exile a creature and create a Gold token if you do.
Repeat.
